blocks.tex: The retained local opening lemmas turn zero dormant lengths into positive lengths while maintaining the closure and turning equations. Surjectivity at a regular four-edge anchor supplies their hypotheses.

The single-wall primitive is
$\mathrm{regularWallZero\_entersInterior}$, stated as
\cref{thm:regularWallZero_entersInterior} in
\cref{chap:discrete_collared_continuation}: at a regular zero of $f$, a kernel
direction $v$ with $w'v>0$ integrates to an exact level-set curve
$\gamma$ with $\gamma(0)=a$, $\gamma'(0)=v$, on which the wall slack $w$ is
strictly positive for all small $t>0$.  This section builds on it.

blocks.label: thm:wc_enters_all
blocks.title: one curve enters all active walls at once
blocks.body:
With finitely many walls and a single $v\in\ker f'$ which is strictly inward
  for every one of them, one curve on the exact fibre enters all of them
  simultaneously.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularWallZero_entersAllInteriors
lean.code:
theorem regularWallZero_entersAllInteriors
    {ι E F : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} {a v : E}
    {w : ι → E → ℝ} {w' : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a)
    (hsurj : f'.range = ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ f'.ker)
    (hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) a)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < w' i v) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → E) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧
      HasDerivAt γ v 0 ∧
      Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < ε →
        f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, w i a < w i (γ t) := by
  let q : f'.ker := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t =>
    hf.implicitFunction f f' hsurj (f a) (t • q)
  have hγ0 : γ 0 = a := by
    simp [γ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_image hsurj]
  have hq_deriv : HasStrictDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • q) q 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasStrictDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).smul_const q)
  have hq_tendsto : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • q) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, zero_smul] using hq_deriv.hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hγ_tendsto : Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [γ] using
      (hf.tendsto_implicitFunction hsurj
        (g₁ := fun _ : ℝ => f a) (g₂ := fun t : ℝ => t • q)
        tendsto_const_nhds hq_tendsto)
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
    simpa [γ, q, Function.comp_def] using
      ((hf.to_implicitFunction hsurj).comp_hasStrictDerivAt_of_eq 0 hq_deriv (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hlevel : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, f (γ t) = f a := by
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f a, t • q)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f a, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hq_tendsto
    simpa [γ] using hp.eventually (hf.map_implicitFunction_eq hsurj)
  have hwall : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (w' i v) 0 := by
    intro i
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (hw i).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ_deriv hγ0.symm
  have hwall_good : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), w i a < w i (γ t) := by
    intro i
    have hslope :
        Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0)))
          (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w' i v)) := by
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (hwall i).tendsto_slope_zero_right
    filter_upwards [hslope.eventually_const_lt (hpos i), self_mem_nhdsWithin]
      with t hs ht
    have hinv : 0 < t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ht
    have hdiff : 0 < w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0) :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_right hs hinv.le
    rw [hγ0] at hdiff
    exact sub_pos.mp hdiff
  have hgood :
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, w i a < w i (γ t) := by
    filter_upwards [hlevel.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      Filter.eventually_all.2 hwall_good] with t hft hwt
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: Regular wall zero enters the interior
deps.label: thm:regularWallZero_entersInterior

blocks.tex:
The curve produced by \cref{thm:regularWallZero_entersInterior} depends only
  on $f$, $a$ and $v$, not on the wall; only the time bound $\varepsilon$ is
  wall-dependent.  Take the minimum of the finitely many $\varepsilon_i$.

blocks.label: thm:wc_purification
blocks.title: active-wall purification
blocks.body:
Suppose all slacks are nonnegative at $a$ and the inward condition
  $0<w'_i v$ is imposed \emph{only} for the walls with $w_i(a)=0$.  Then the
  same conclusion holds: one exact-fibre curve makes \emph{every} slack
  strictly positive for small positive time.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
lean.code:
theorem regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
    {ι E F : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} {a v : E}
    {w : ι → E → ℝ} {w' : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a)
    (hsurj : f'.range = ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ f'.ker)
    (hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) a)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i a)
    (hinward : ∀ i, w i a = 0 → 0 < w' i v) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → E) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧
      HasDerivAt γ v 0 ∧
      Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < ε →
        f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, 0 < w i (γ t) := by
  let q : f'.ker := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t =>
    hf.implicitFunction f f' hsurj (f a) (t • q)
  have hγ0 : γ 0 = a := by
    simp [γ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_image hsurj]
  have hq_deriv : HasStrictDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • q) q 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasStrictDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).smul_const q)
  have hq_tendsto : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • q) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, zero_smul] using hq_deriv.hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hγ_tendsto : Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [γ] using
      (hf.tendsto_implicitFunction hsurj
        (g₁ := fun _ : ℝ => f a) (g₂ := fun t : ℝ => t • q)
        tendsto_const_nhds hq_tendsto)
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
    simpa [γ, q, Function.comp_def] using
      ((hf.to_implicitFunction hsurj).comp_hasStrictDerivAt_of_eq 0 hq_deriv (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hlevel : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, f (γ t) = f a := by
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f a, t • q)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f a, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hq_tendsto
    simpa [γ] using hp.eventually (hf.map_implicitFunction_eq hsurj)
  have hstrict : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < w i (γ t) := by
    intro i
    rcases eq_or_ne (w i a) 0 with hactive | hinactive
    · have hwall : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (w' i v) 0 := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          (hw i).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ_deriv hγ0.symm
      have hslope :
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0)))
            (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w' i v)) := by
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hwall.tendsto_slope_zero_right
      filter_upwards [hslope.eventually_const_lt (hinward i hactive),
        self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t hs ht
      have hinv : 0 < t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ht
      have hdiff : 0 < w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0) :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_right hs hinv.le
      rw [hγ0, hactive] at hdiff
      simpa using hdiff
    · have hbase : 0 < w i a := lt_of_le_of_ne (hclosed i) (Ne.symm hinactive)
      have hcont : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (w i a)) := by
        have hwcont : ContinuousAt (w i) a := (hw i).continuousAt
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: one curve enters all active walls at once
deps.label: thm:wc_enters_all

blocks.tex:
The active slacks become positive by \cref{thm:wc_enters_all}.  Each
  inactive slack is strictly positive at $a$, hence stays positive along the
  curve for small time by continuity; there are finitely many, so one common
  time bound works.

A closed moderate anchor may have some edge lengths equal to $0$ while every
arcsine wall is still strict --- a \emph{dormant} anchor.  The collapsed
lengths are then the active walls, and the criterion above applies with the
length-only closure controller.

blocks.label: lem:wc_dormant_walls
blocks.title: sub-cap lengths satisfy the arcsine walls
blocks.body:
If $\kappa$ is positive and $0\le\ell_i<\mathrm{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i$ for every
  $i$, then $|\kappa_i\ell_{i-1}/2|<1$ and $|\kappa_i\ell_i/2|<1$ for every $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
lean.code:
lemma strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap [NeZero n]
    {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ} (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i) :
    ∀ i, |kappa i * (ell (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
      |kappa i * (ell i / 2)| < 1 := by
  intro i
  constructor
  · have hraw := endpoint_wall_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
      (e := i - 1) (c := kappa i) (t := ell (i - 1)) (hkappa i)
      (by simp) (hell (i - 1)).1 (hell (i - 1)).2
    rw [abs_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (hkappa i).le (div_nonneg (hell (i - 1)).1 zero_le_two))]
    exact hraw
  · have hraw := endpoint_wall_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
      (e := i) (c := kappa i) (t := ell i) (hkappa i)
      (le_max_left (kappa i) (kappa (i + 1))) (hell i).1 (hell i).2
    rw [abs_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (hkappa i).le (div_nonneg (hell i).1 zero_le_two))]
    exact hraw

blocks.tex:
The edge cap is exactly the length at which the corresponding arcsine
  argument reaches $1$; being strictly below it on both sides gives both
  inequalities, and nonnegativity gives the lower one.

blocks.label: thm:wc_dormant_deriv
blocks.title: the length controller is strictly differentiable at zero lengths
blocks.body:
Under the same hypotheses, $L\mapsto\mathrm{closureMapR3}(\kappa,L)$ has a
  strict derivative at $\ell$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
lean.code:
theorem lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap [NeZero n]
    {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ} (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L))
      (fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell) ell := by
  have hw := strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hkappa hell
  have hE := contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths (κ := kappa) (ℓ := ell) hw
  have hT := contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths (κ := kappa) (ℓ := ell) hw
  have hC : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L ↦ (closureGap kappa L, turningSum kappa L - 2 * Real.pi)) ell :=
    hE.prodMk (hT.sub contDiffAt_const)
  simpa only [closureMapR3] using hC.hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero

deps.title: sub-cap lengths satisfy the arcsine walls
deps.label: lem:wc_dormant_walls

deps.title: Configuration space, closure map, parameter projection
deps.label: def:collar_solution_sets

blocks.tex:
The closure controller is built from $\arcsin$ of the wall arguments and
  from $\exp$; \cref{lem:wc_dormant_walls} keeps every $\arcsin$ argument
  strictly inside $(-1,1)$, where $\arcsin$ is smooth.  A vanishing
  \emph{length} is harmless: the singular points of the controller are the
  wall saturations, not the collapsed edges.

blocks.label: thm:wc_dormant_opens
blocks.title: a regular dormant anchor opens
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge3$, $\kappa$ positive, $0\le\ell<\mathrm{edgeCap}$, and
  $\mathrm{closureMapR3}(\kappa,\ell)=0$.  If the controller derivative at
  $\ell$ is surjective and some kernel vector $v$ has $v_i>0$ at every
  collapsed coordinate $\ell_i=0$, then $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {kappa ell v : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (kappa, ell) = 0)
    {F' : (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ × ℝ}
    (hF : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) F' ell)
    (hsurj : F'.range = ⊤) (hv : v ∈ F'.ker)
    (hvinward : ∀ i, ell i = 0 → 0 < v i) :
    RealizesR2 kappa := by
  let w : (ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) → (ZMod n → ℝ) → ℝ
    | Sum.inl i => fun L ↦ L i
    | Sum.inr i => fun L ↦ edgeCap kappa i - L i
  let w' : (ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) → (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ
    | Sum.inl i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj i
    | Sum.inr i => -(ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)
  have hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) ell := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · simpa [w, w'] using (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) i ell)
    · simpa [w, w'] using
        (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) i ell).const_sub (edgeCap kappa i)
  have hclosed : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i ell := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · simpa [w] using (hell i).1
    · simpa [w] using (sub_nonneg.mpr (hell i).2.le)
  have hinward : ∀ i, w i ell = 0 → 0 < w' i v := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · intro hi
      simpa [w, w'] using hvinward i (by simpa [w] using hi)
    · intro hi
      have hi' : edgeCap kappa i - ell i = 0 := by simpa [w] using hi
      exfalso
      linarith [(hell i).2]
  obtain ⟨gamma, eps, heps, _hgamma0, _hgammaDeriv, _hgammaLim, hgood⟩ :=
    regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
      (ι := ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) hF hsurj hv hw hclosed hinward
  have ht : eps / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) eps :=
    ⟨half_pos heps, half_lt_self heps⟩
  obtain ⟨hlevel, hwalls⟩ := hgood (eps / 2) ht.1 ht.2
  have hbounds : ∀ i, 0 < gamma (eps / 2) i ∧
      gamma (eps / 2) i < edgeCap kappa i := by
    intro i
    have hlow := hwalls (Sum.inl i)
    have hupp := hwalls (Sum.inr i)
    change 0 < gamma (eps / 2) i at hlow
    change 0 < edgeCap kappa i - gamma (eps / 2) i at hupp
    exact ⟨hlow, sub_pos.mp hupp⟩
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 kappa (gamma (eps / 2)) :=
    (moderateArc_zero_iff_edge hkappa).2 hbounds
  have hzero' : closureMapR3 (kappa, gamma (eps / 2)) = 0 :=
    hlevel.trans hzero
  exact realizesR2_of_mem_collarInterior hn
    (S := Set.univ) ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hMA, hzero'⟩ hkappa

deps.title: the length controller is strictly differentiable at zero lengths
deps.label: thm:wc_dormant_deriv

blocks.tex:
Take as wall family the $2n$ slacks indexed by $\ZMod n\sqcup\ZMod n$: the
  lower slacks $L\mapsto L_i$ and the upper slacks
  $L\mapsto\mathrm{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i - L_i$.  Both are affine, so their
  derivatives are the coordinate projection and its negative.  All $2n$ are
  nonnegative at $\ell$ by hypothesis, and \emph{no upper slack is active},
  because $\ell_i<\mathrm{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i$ strictly; so the active set is
  exactly the collapsed coordinates, on which $v$ is strictly inward by
  hypothesis.  \cref{thm:wc_purification} then supplies a curve on the exact
  closure fibre along which all $2n$ slacks are strictly positive; evaluate it
  at any small positive time.  The resulting length vector has
  $0<\ell'_i<\mathrm{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i$ for every $i$, which is exactly
  $\mathrm{ModerateArc}$ in its edgewise form, and it still lies on the
  closure fibre of $0$.  A strictly moderate closed anchor with positive
  $\kappa$ is an interior point of the collar, hence realizes $\kappa$ by
  \cref{lem:collar_realizes_of_mem}.

blocks.label: cor:wc_dormant_active_surj
blocks.title: surjectivity away from the collapsed coordinates suffices
blocks.body:
It is enough that every controller target be produced by a correction
  supported away from the collapsed coordinates.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor_of_active_surj
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor_of_active_surj [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (kappa, ell) = 0)
    (hactive : ∀ y : ℂ × ℝ, ∃ b : ZMod n → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell b = y ∧
        ∀ i, ell i = 0 → b i = 0) :
    RealizesR2 kappa := by
  let F' := fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell
  have hF : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) F' ell :=
    lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hkappa hell
  have hsurj : F'.range = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    intro y
    obtain ⟨b, hb, _⟩ := hactive y
    exact ⟨b, by simpa [F'] using hb⟩
  let d : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i ↦ if ell i = 0 then 1 else 0
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbzero⟩ := hactive (-F' d)
  let v := d + b
  have hv : v ∈ F'.ker := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change F' (d + b) = 0
    rw [map_add]
    change F' b = -F' d at hb
    rw [hb, add_neg_cancel]
  have hvinward : ∀ i, ell i = 0 → 0 < v i := by
    intro i hi
    change 0 < d i + b i
    rw [show d i = 1 by simp [d, hi], hbzero i hi]
    norm_num
  exact realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor hn hkappa hell hzero
    hF hsurj hv hvinward

blocks.tex:
Surjectivity is immediate from the hypothesis.  For the kernel vector, let
  $d$ be the indicator of the collapsed set ($d_i=1$ if $\ell_i=0$, else $0$)
  and use the hypothesis at the target $-F'd$ to get $b$ with $F'b=-F'd$ and
  $b_i=0$ at every collapsed $i$.  Then $v=d+b$ satisfies $F'v=0$ and
  $v_i = 1 + 0 = 1 > 0$ at every collapsed coordinate, which is exactly what
  \cref{thm:wc_dormant_opens} requires.  This is the form sparse four-edge
  anchors can actually supply: one need not exhibit the kernel vector, only
  solve the controller using edges that are already open.
